verdict.rationale: Kick documents connecting to 12,000+ banks and credit cards through Plaid as the primary method, and says transactions arrive from a bank feed and sync in automatically, where they are categorized and run through rules. The docs never state how often the feed syncs, so the daily cadence the story asks for is only implied. Missing for 10: documented daily or recurring sync frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of feed reliability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Plaid: connects to 12,000+ banks and credit cards. The primary method for most accounts.
Kick connects to your financial institutions through Plaid
Every transaction in Kick comes from a bank feed or an import.
Once a rule is created, it runs automatically every time a matching transaction syncs.
